note: Tunable numbers for the Quora feed scan. Edit these values to change scan behavior — the scan job reads this file fresh on every run, so changes apply to the next run with nothing to restart. Do NOT edit the cron .md file directly: it is a read-only copy and changes there have no effect. Block cap: max_blocks_per_scan=50, two-tier — 25 blocks WITH follower sweeps (group1_sweep_cap), then 25 assess-and-block with NO follower sweeps and NO new waves (group2_nosweep_cap); after 50 total blocks the scan purges any remaining queued profiles and closes. block_cap_suspended=false means the cap is in force; set true to suspend it. assessment_only_mode=false: full mode is the default — assess, follower-sweep Reds, block, and report spam/CSAM Reds after blocking; assessment-only only on explicit instruction.
